newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway's Protector gets takeover offer.
newsitem.headline: Norway's Protector gets takeover offer.

text.p: Norwegian insurance group Protector ASA said on Wednesday Zurich Insurance Company of Switzerland had formally offered to buy out the Norwegian group.
Zurich Insurance offered Protector shareholders 230 crowns per share, valuing the company at 550 million crowns, according to Protector's statement to the Oslo bourse.
The offer is dependent on Zurich Insurance obtaining 90 percent of the stock in Protector.
"Protector's board has considered the offer both from a strategic viewpoint and in regard to the price. The board recommends to shareholders to accept the offer," the statement said.
The takeover would result in an increased competitive position for the company in both existing and new markets, it said.
Jan Lenbor would remain as managing director while Ole Lund would continue as chairman of the board.
